meta.note: All records are synthetic. Every number on the dashboard is calculated from the records below. Change a record, reload the page, and all views update.

proposed_change.summary: Adds the outage map to the services covered by the agreement from 1 Jan 2027. Deadline and target stay the same.

rules.status_text: GREEN only when all three checks pass. RED when the forecast is more than 3 points below the contract target, or a high-severity downgrade alert is open. AMBER otherwise. Accepted exceptions still count as exposure.
rules.hndl_text: HNDL rating per connection: HIGH = high-sensitivity data that stays valuable 5+ years. MEDIUM = high-sensitivity data with a shorter life, or medium-sensitivity data that stays valuable 1+ year. LOW = everything else (for example telemetry that is worthless within days).
rules.readiness_text: Readiness = share of connections using ML-KEM (X25519MLKEM768), weighted by data sensitivity (high 3×, medium 2×, low 1×). Measured monthly per service. A scope's score is the average of its services, weighted by connection volume.
rules.forecast_text: Forecast = today's score + the average monthly gain of the last 3 months × months left until the contract deadline.

cio.label: CIO
cio.question: Are we on track for our biggest customer?
cio.stance: No customer outages, no extra budget this year, meet the contract deadline.

pm.label: Project Manager
pm.question: How close are we, and what is blocking us?
pm.stance: Keep fallback for legacy field devices until certified replacements arrive in 2028.

sec.label: Security Officer
sec.question: What can be harvested today and decrypted later?
sec.stance: Disable classical fallback on all connections by the end of this quarter.

status.can: Whether we are on track for the contract deadline and whether recorded traffic is still at risk.
status.cannot: How far we are from green. The three checks behind it show which condition fails.

deadline.can: Whether the forecast reaches the contract target by the deadline if the current pace continues.
deadline.cannot: Whether the pace will continue. A delayed firmware wave lowers the forecast.

readiness.can: How much of the traffic already uses quantum-safe key exchange, weighted by how sensitive it is.
readiness.cannot: That we are secure. One weak, long-lived connection can matter more than the score suggests.

hndl.can: How much sensitive, long-lived data travels over classical key exchange each week.
hndl.cannot: Whether anyone is actually recording it, or when quantum decryption becomes practical.

alerts.changed: A new network hop (10.4.7.22) appeared in the path
alerts.action: Isolate the link and compare the route with the last known good one.
Check the gateway's TLS policy; watch for repeats.

alerts.changed: TLS policy reset by a software update

planned_steps.title: Firmware wave 2 on 4 devices
planned_steps.customer_impact: The meter portal restarts for about 20 minutes in the night window.

planned_steps.title: Switch off fallback everywhere (proposed by Security)
planned_steps.customer_impact: Devices that cannot use the new encryption go offline. The meter portal and outage map would lose data.

planned_steps.title: Replace the outage-map feed server
planned_steps.customer_impact: The outage map is read-only for about 1 hour.

planned_steps.title: Install 2 certified replacement units
planned_steps.customer_impact: No customer impact. Work happens in the maintenance window.

risks.title: Customer and control data can be recorded now and read later
risks.plain: Some links still use old encryption for data that stays valuable for years. Someone could record it today and decrypt it once quantum computers are strong enough.
risks.decision: Protect the December firmware update and keep the funded replacements on schedule.

risks.title: Suspected tampering on an internal link
risks.plain: One internal link suddenly stopped using the new encryption. Security is investigating. Customer services are not affected.
risks.decision: No decision yet. Security reports by 19 Nov.

risks.title: Customer asks to add the outage map to the agreement
risks.plain: The proposed change adds our least-ready service. If accepted as is, the contract forecast drops to the edge of the target.
risks.decision: Accept as proposed, or negotiate a later date for the outage map.

risks.title: December update is the critical step
risks.plain: Most of the remaining gain depends on one firmware update on 15 December. If it slips, the deadline is at risk.
risks.decision: Keep the 15 Dec window free of other changes.

risks.title: Corporate systems are falling behind
risks.plain: Badge and camera systems are the least ready, but they are not covered by the customer agreement.

notification_rules.when: High-severity downgrade alert on any service
Problem that affects a service covered by the customer agreement
Contract forecast falls below the target
Exception expired or expiring within 30 days

notifications.title: Suspected attack on an internal link
notifications.detail: An internal link stopped using quantum-safe encryption after a network change. Security is investigating. Customer services are not affected.

notifications.title: Unusual failures on a billing link
notifications.detail: A billing link fell back to old encryption after repeated failures. It affects a service covered by the Kestrel Water agreement.

notifications.title: Customer proposed a contract change
notifications.detail: Kestrel Water wants the outage map covered from 1 Jan 2027.

notifications.title: Exception expired without review
notifications.detail: The fallback exception for a pumping-station controller expired on 1 Nov.
